Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
I should have included this in my other post, but I just thought of this one:

If a Deep Song combat concludes, and Psyche is played, does the real
acting minion revert to being the acting minion for the purposes of
combat? (I assume yes on this one)

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:


Adding an extra one : Who gets to play Psyche! first - the real actin
minion (who played Deep Song) or the other one ?

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:


First combat, the reacting or "acting" minion. Second combat, the
acting minion.

To Floppy, yes, the real acting minin reverts as it i a new combat and
effects do not carry across.
